source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent folded banner ribbon progressing from pale marker-pencil construction to bold felt-tip outlines and saturated marker color.
source.notes: Keep one centered blank banner with one long front panel, two folded-back return sections, two fishtail ends, four visible overlap seams, two long highlight gaps, two small corner glints, three short shadow hatches, and one shallow broken shadow stable. No letters, words, face, sticker border, badge frame, extra ribbon, arrows, numbers, labels, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only fold.

process_strategy: Lock the front panel, fold-return routes, fishtail notches, overlap seams, highlight gaps, and shadow footprint in pale construction; establish every ribbon contour and overlap before inking; then color only the already visible sections so the finish stays cumulative, face-free, and handmade.

final_elements.name: centerline, front-panel box, fold-return routes, fishtail notches, and shadow guide
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one long center panel, symmetrical return paths, two tail notches, and one shallow broken shadow.

final_elements.name: complete front panel, two folded-back returns, and two fishtail ends
final_elements.description: One continuous outer contour turns the guides into a readable blank banner with clear depth and two notched tails.

final_elements.name: four overlap seams, inner fold edges, two long highlight gaps, two corner glints, and three short shadow hatches
final_elements.description: Four seam changes clarify which ribbon sections pass in front, while two long open highlights, two small corner glints, and short hatches map the later value pattern.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip keeper outlines and clarified ribbon overlaps
final_elements.description: Imperfect bold outlines reinforce every established edge and seam while keeping the center panel blank.

final_elements.name: raspberry front panel, teal returns, golden tails, purple fold shadows, and warm-gray ground shadow
final_elements.description: Saturated marker fills separate the established ribbon planes with visible streaks and preserved paper highlights.

rejection_checks: The same centered ribbon, front-panel width, return depth, tail angles, notch shapes, overlap seams, and shadow footprint must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one blank front panel, two folded-back returns, two fishtail ends, four overlap seams, two long highlight gaps, and two small corner glints must appear before the final panel and persist.
No letter, word, logo, face, sticker outline, badge frame, extra ribbon, prop, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only fold may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and handmade edge variation rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
